## Summary / 变更说明

Explain the problem, scope and user-visible behavior. Link related issues if applicable.

## Verification / 验证

- [ ] `npm run package` passes locally; attach sanitized test evidence.
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed behavior; real-service testing is listed separately.
- [ ] English / 简中文档和界面已同步更新。
- [ ] No new remote write permissions, telemetry or automatic dependency installation.
- [ ] No credentials, private URLs, user data, note backups or private screenshots in the diff.
- [ ] Dependency license/privacy implications reviewed; generated notices updated if needed.

## Risks and migration / 风险与迁移

Describe state changes, compatibility, rollback and manual acceptance still needed.
